records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Revenue: For fiscal 2022, revenue was $26.5 billion, an increase of 25 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase in subscription and support revenues for fiscal 2022 was primarily caused by volume-driven increases from new business, which includes new customers, upgrades, additional subscriptions from existing customers and acquisition activity.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Remaining Performance Obligation: Total remaining performance obligation as of January 31, 2022 was approximately $43.7 billion, which includes approximately $1.2 billion of remaining performance obligation related to Slack, an increase of 21 percent year-over-year.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: As a result of our aggressive growth plans and integration of our previously acquired businesses, we have incurred significant expenses for equity awards and amortization of purchased intangibles, which have reduced our operating income.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: •Cash: Cash provided by operations for fiscal 2022 was $6.0 billion, an increase of 25 percent year-over-year.
